etymologies.etymologyHTML: G (upper case, lower case g, plural Gs or G's)
G (countable and uncountable, plural Gs)

definitions.definition: (sports, baseball) Games (the statistic reporting the number of games that a player has participated in).
(US, of a movie) General (suitable for a general audience).
(chiefly US) Abbreviation of grand (“thousand (dollars, pounds etc.)”).

quote.citation: 1994, The Notorious B.I.G. (lyrics and music), “Juicy”, in Ready to Die, performed by The Notorious B.I.G.:
quote.text: Super Nintendo, Sega Genesis / When I was dead broke, man, I couldn't picture this / 50-inch screen, money-green leather sofa / Got two rides, a limousine with a chauffeur / Phone bill about two G's flat / No need to worry, my accountant handles that / And my whole crew is loungin' / Celebratin' every day, no more public housin'

quote.citation: 2005, “Stay Fly”, in Jordan Houston, Darnell Carlton, Paul Beauregard, Premro Smith, Marlon Goodwin, David Brown, Willie Hutchinson (lyrics), Most Known Unknown‎[1], performed by Three 6 Mafia (featuring Young Buck, 8 Ball, and MJG), Sony BMG:
quote.text: Just really want to smoke my weed, fuck these hoes, and stack my Gs.

quote.citation: 2010 September 9, Gloria Campisi, “Psychologist sues city for 100G, alleging beating by cop earlier this year”, in Philadelphia Inquirer:
quote.text: Psychologist sues city for 100G, alleging beating by cop earlier this year

quote.citation: 2023, Nathan Bryon, Tom Melia, directed by Raine Allen-Miller, Rye Lane, spoken by Nathan (Simon Manyonda):
quote.text: See the hoverboard-riding geezer? This close to payin' a G for a shot of my cousin Calvin's molars.

definitions.definition: (UK, education) The academic grade that comes next below F.
(slang) Abbreviation of gangster; often used to address one's friend.

quote.citation: 1995 August 1, “Gangsta's Paradise”, in Gangsta's Paradise, performed by Coolio featuring L.V.:
quote.text: I'm the kinda G the little homies wanna be like / On my knees in the night, sayin' prayers in the streetlight

quote.citation: 2014, Skepta, Jme (lyrics and music), “That's Not Me” (track 10), in Konnichiwa, performed by Skepta featuring Jme:
quote.text: Love for the G's in the ends / But we don't love no girls in the ends / Last time I fell in love with a sket / But trust me, I will never do that again

definitions.definition: Alternative letter-case form of g (unit of gravitational acceleration).
(drug slang) Short for gamma-hydroxybutyrate or gamma-butyrolactone.

quote.citation: 2017, James Wharton, Something for the Weekend‎[2], Biteback Publishing, →ISBN:
quote.text: Friday afternoon, 4.30. The order has gone to my dealer: two bags of meph, 50ml of G.

definitions.definition: (nautical, historical) Initialism of grog: marked in the ship's books when a sailor took the daily rum ration
